packageRules.description: Group all non-major updates together and merge them once checks pass

Hold TypeScript below 7: typescript-eslint rejects it (typescript-eslint#10940), SvelteKit needs its compiler API, and svelte-check --tsgo misses parse errors (sveltejs/language-tools#3185). Remove this rule once a fresh install with typescript 7 passes check, lint and build
clsx is feature-complete and a dependency of Svelte itself
Registry dependencies: raise the published range to the newest version and wait for a registry.version bump in the same PR
